newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's steel mill net profit fell in 96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's steel mill net profit fell in 96.

text.p: Morocco's steel mill giant Sonasid published on Friday provisional net profits of 165.8 million dirhams ($17.82 million) for 1996 compared with 175.5 million dirhams the previous year.
A spokesman for the firm said the drop was attributed to a slump in real estate business which affected sales during the first half of 1996.
Sonasid turnover for 1996 stood at 1.7 billion dirhams. No comparative figure was available for the year before.
The government sold 35 percent of the company's stake last year in a flotation worth 420 million dirhams and plans to sell between 35 and 62 percent to set up a hard core of shareholders.
was last traded on March 20 at 532 dirhams.
